text:
Maria Chen: Hey folks — I pushed updates to PR #3127, addressing the schema feedback from yesterday. The big change is a small proto addition (see snippet below) and a migration shim for older consumers. PTAL when you have a minute.
Kevin Patel: Thanks — will take a look this afternoon.
Rahul Singh: Quick Q: does this require a rolling restart of the serving fleet? or is it backward compatible?
Maria Chen: It’s additive-only. Older clients ignore the new field, but servers need to start emitting it to enable the new Optimize path. No mandatory restart, but we should do a staged rollout.
Olivia Gomez: Can you add a config flag to gate the new field until canary passes? we’ve had issues with early rollouts.
Maria Chen: Yep — added flag `enable_response_metadata` and defaulted it to false. Canary will flip it. Example: `--service-flags enable_response_metadata=true`.
Kevin Patel: Two tiny nits in the generated code, left inline comments in the PR. None are blockers.
Maria Chen: Addressed both nits, re-generated the protos, pushed. Also added a brief migration note in the CHANGELOG.
Rahul Singh: Can you paste the proto diff here? quicker to eyeball than opening PR.
Maria Chen: Sure —
```
diff --git a/inference.proto b/inference.proto
@@
 message Response {
+  // Optional metadata emitted by the runtime for routing/metrics.
+  ResponseMetadata response_metadata = 12;
 }
+
+message ResponseMetadata {
+  map<string, string> headers = 1;
+  uint64 latency_ms = 2;
+}
```
Olivia Gomez: LGTM for the proto shape. Question: do we need to bump the proto package version? we prefer explicit version tag in the git submodule.
Maria Chen: I incremented the proto_version in the repo manifest to 2.1.0 and added a release note.
CI Bot: Build passed: //infra:protos (bazel) — 1 job failed earlier but fixed in latest push.
Kevin Patel: Ran `bazel test //...` locally, all green. Left an approve on GitHub — will remove if anything else appears.
Rahul Singh: Approve from me too once CI finishes. schedule canary when you’re ready.
Maria Chen: Thanks — I’ll schedule a small canary tomorrow AM (UTC-8). Will flip the `enable_response_metadata` flag on the canary subset, monitor latency and error rates. If all good, gradually expand over 4 hours.
Olivia Gomez: Ping me when canary is live, I’ll watch traces and cost breakdowns.
Maria Chen: Will do. Re-requesting review so the PR gets commit queue: PTAL @Kevin Patel @Rahul Singh @Olivia Gomez :pray:
Kevin Patel: PTAL acknowledged, re-checking the last gen-proto commit.
Olivia Gomez: Re-approve once canary scheduled. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: CI passed at 1768890200.
Maria Chen: Updated commit message for merge queue, thanks everyone.
